message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. Facts: Defendant Zhang used false company info, pretended to be deputy general manager, signed contracts, then collected guarantee deposits from victims (total 2.04 million RMB) by promising contract work that he didn't have rights to. He defrauded them. This is contract fraud (合同诈骗). The list includes "合同诈骗". Also possibly "诈骗" generic. In examples, for similar scenario (contract fraud) they used "合同诈骗". Example: earlier case with rental car fraud used "诈骗". But that was simple fraud. Here it's specifically contract fraud: he used false documents to get money. So label: 合同诈骗.

Check if any other charge like "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" - he used false company documents, but not state documents. Not that.

Thus answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
